verifications.note: Verified on candidate sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272 (source 7579382c, 3158 files; recomputed in the repository tree at the start and end, and in my clone). The fix commit c4bb0cf8b is an ancestor of 7579382c. Since round 6 the only changes outside delivery records are docs/handover (README, deployment.md, deployment.ar-summary.md, known-limitations.md, known-limitations.ar-summary.md, release-notes.md) and tools/release (release-notes.mjs, release-notes-disclosures.json, secret-allowlist.json, release-notes.test.mjs). No product, drill or migration code changed. Each surface that ADR-0064 A5.6 names now carries all three required statements, in English and in provisional Arabic: (1) a scheduled job that runs during the drill is explained only as A5.2 says and is listed in the report (schedule-explained-d9.json and the D9 report fields); (2) a handler that writes business rows in the window still makes D9 fail, and that is not a data defect; (3) the recovery is to re-run the drill and never pause or reschedule a job. The surfaces are known-limitations.md (new 'ADR-0064 Amendment 5 (D-278)' row in section 6), the release notes (new section, EN and AR), deployment.md's drill section, known-limitations.ar-summary.md item 7 and deployment.ar-summary.md. The texts agree with A5.2 (no initiating user, schedule trigger, enabled job_schedule row, slot of that row's cron and timezone inside (W0-60 s, W1] on the target clock, created in the window, own worker audit event, one per slot) and with A5.7: residual 1 (kpi.reporting_period_open still fails, named in known-limitations), residual 3 (engine ticks not covered) and residual 4 (pg-boss 11.0.0 timing). They also agree with the drill code: schedule-explained.mjs runs one READ ONLY transaction and transfer-drill.sh never writes job_schedule. One small difference: the deployment Arabic summary omits the pg-boss 11.0.0 sentence. It is a summary, the Arabic known-limitations summary carries that sentence, and it is not one of the three required statements. Reproducibility: release-notes --check exit 0, known-limitations --check (protocol-audit-r7.json) exit 0, check-handover exit 0. Mutations in a disposable clone are caught: a removed EN or AR statement and an empty list give exit 1, and an unknown key or a missing file gives exit 2. Two real transfer drills on this candidate's archive passed D0-D11 (matched), and the A18 harness passed 10/10. The ADR-0071 text drift that the new generator input causes is raised separately as F-DG7-973 (Low). It does not reopen this finding.

I am a non-author of the fix (AN-P7I and DO-D10). Verified on candidate sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272, as for F-DG7-972. The finding's expected result is fully met. known-limitations.md and the release notes, as well as deployment.md, carry the three A5.6 statements. known-limitations.md carries the open A5.7 residuals (engine ticks not covered; S6/S7 timing on pg-boss 11.0.0 defaults). The Arabic summaries follow the English text and are marked provisional (deployment.ar-summary.md omits only the pg-boss sentence, which known-limitations.ar-summary.md carries).
